headline: Community forum on the Ends Policy update and action on revised Executive Limitation 2.4, Financial Condition and Activities.
summary: The meeting includes a closed executive session, a community forum on the Ends Policy update, and an action item on revised Executive Limitation 2.4. It also covers a consent agenda with accounts payable and payroll approvals.
items: Closed executive session on employment, attorney-client communication, labor negotiations, and real estate
Public comment period on any topic
Community forum on the Ends Policy update (second reading)
Action item: revised Executive Limitation 2.4, Financial Condition and Activities (second reading)
Superintendent's report on website updates and the start of the school year
Consent agenda: approve minutes of August 12 and 19, 2026; approve accounts payable orders and checks; approve payroll warrants; set the September 16, 2026 agenda; review future agenda items
Consent agenda item marked for action: accounts payable checks, including $156,116.87 to Vermont Mechanical Inc. and $113,610.00 to Goldfield Construction Management, Inc.
location: 577 Dorset Street, South Burlington School District
